messages:
Zoe: Quick pop-up at 12:30 10-min kettlebell circuit + 1-min plank-off after? Low impact, bring a light bell if you have one. :weight_lifter: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Marco: Im in. What weight are we thinking? I have 8kg and 12kg.
Priya: 8kg sounds perfect for me. Can I just do the plank-off? Meeting at 1.
Ethan: Ill join the circuit. No plank-off for me  my core is lying about its fitness level. :joy:
Zoe: Circuit idea: 3 rounds of 45s work / 15s rest  swings, goblet squat, single-arm row (L/R counted as one), kettlebell halo. Plank-off after for anyone who wants.
Fitbot: Event created: "12:30 kettlebell circuit + plank-off" (20m). Reminder 5m before.
Marco: Logistics Q  mats available? I might want a mat for the plank.
Priya: Mats in the storeroom labelled "Wellness"  please wipe after. Towels by locker 2.
Ethan: Safety note: keep core braced on rows, no jerky reps. If youre new to KB, start without weight or use a light dumbbell.
Zoe: Warmup: 3 mins easy jog on the spot + arm circles. Well demo form quickly before starting.
Marco: Ill bring a spare 6kg for beginners. Also tiny prize: winner of plank-off gets a sticker. :star2:
Priya: Sticker?? Sold. Ill do the plank-off if I finish the meeting. Maybe 45s max though. :sweat_smile:
Ethan: Count: circuit 3 (Zoe, Marco, Ethan), plank-only 1 (Priya), observer 0 (open invite).
Zoe: Meetup: wellness nook at 12:25. If raining we shift to the small conference room (quiet please).
Marco: See you in 20. Bringing hand sanitizer and a smile.
Priya: Ill swing by for the plank if my calendar lets me. Post a 1-line recap here after.
Zoe: Great. Quick etiquette: clean hands, and no ego lifts. Enjoy!"
